selection_rationale: MPF-01 removes the inherited factor-two loss and is the essential order lemma. MPF-10 is the proposed quantified attaining theorem, while MPF-11 is its matching, carefully delimited certificate barrier. MPF-03 is a proved local ingredient but is subsumed by MPF-10/11 and is not counted as a fourth survivor. Seven of the eight non-surviving mechanisms are killed, meeting the 80% falsification gate.
